map.月供 M = P·i·(1+i)^n / ((1+i)^n - 1)，P 本金、: Payment M = P·i·(1+i)^n / ((1+i)^n − 1), P principal, i monthly rate, n months. Loan 150k, annual 6% (monthly 0.5%), 3 years (36 periods): M≈150000×0.005×1.196/0.196≈4,560, total interest ≈ 14,160.
map.利率从 4% 升到 8%，同本金同期限月供明显上升、总息近翻倍；长期限降低月供但: Rate from 4% to 8%: same principal and term, payment rises clearly and total interest nearly doubles; longer term lowers the monthly payment but raises total interest — weigh cash flow against cost.
map.等额本息每月还款相同（前期利息占比高）；等额本金每月本金固定、月供递减、总息更少: Equal-installment has the same payment each month (interest dominates early); equal-principal has fixed monthly principal, declining payment and less total interest but higher early pressure. Car loans usually use equal-installment.
map.月利率怎么算？: How to compute the monthly rate?
map.年利率/12。如年化 6% 月息 0.5%；注意「费率」与「利率」不同，费率口径: Annual rate / 12. E.g. 6% annual → 0.5% monthly; note 'fee rate' differs from 'interest rate' — a fee-rate basis often costs more than the surface number.
